# A landing render undoes a checkbox's checked vnode sync, so a click is written back over

## Context

@neo-opus-grace's `defect-note` from 2026-09-16T13:36Z, broadcast unowned while she closed #18792 for `form.field.Text`: the same class lives in `form.field.CheckBox`, and nothing was tracking it.

**Reproduced deterministically on `dev` (`aadafbad1b`), unit runtime.** Two clicks with the first render held open between its payload collection and its landing:

```
HELD   : []
SETTLED: ["checked-sync-…__input=false"]
```

The settled render re-sends `checked="false"` that the DOM already holds. Held open, the intermediate click is visually reverted until the next render lands — invisible at normal speed, which is what makes it expensive to diagnose from the symptom.

**The symptom class has cost a debugging session before.** On 2026-02-25 (session `6c17bf58-3525-492f-af63-98411c45ef22`) @tobiu reported *"clicks no longer change the checked state at all"* and wrote *"i suppose the checkbox might get reset so fast on dom level, that i can not visually see it… even if we monkey-patch around this bug, the next user will encounter it sooner or later."* That session attributed the failure to a state-provider binding and repaired it there. This ticket does **not** claim that incident was this defect — the attribution then was its own, and the engine mechanism below was not measured until now. It is cited because the reading *"reset so fast on dom level"* describes exactly what the reproducer shows, and because it is the reason to fix the engine rather than the consumer.

Live latest-open sweep: latest 20 open issues read at 2026-09-17T09:12Z; nothing equivalent. Targeted `in:title` searches on checkbox / checked / vnode sync returned empty, as did `grep` over `resources/content/issues` and `resources/content/discussions` for `form.field.CheckBox` and `onInputValueChange`. A2A sweep of the latest 30 messages: Grace's `defect-note` is the only mention and carries no lane claim. Own-assignment sweep: no overlap across my 7 open tickets.

## The Problem

`CheckBox#onInputValueChange` writes what the DOM reports into the input's vnode so the next diff has nothing to send — the DOM already holds it:

```js
me.vnode.childNodes[0].childNodes[me.hideLabel ? 0 : 1].attributes.checked = `${checked}`;
```

A render collected **before** that report lands **after** it, carrying the vnode it was diffed against. That vnode does not hold the reported state, so the sync is silently undone, and the next diff computes against a stale `checked`. The user's click is written back over.

This is the identical mechanism #18792 measured for `Text`, one field class across. `Text` writes `attributes.value`; `CheckBox` writes `attributes.checked`. Neither write survives a render that was already in the air.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/form/field/CheckBox.mjs:610-620` — `onInputValueChange()` performs the sync by index-walking `me.vnode.childNodes[0].childNodes[me.hideLabel ? 0 : 1]`, then assigns `me.checked`.
- `src/form/field/CheckBox.mjs:9` — `class CheckBox extends Field` (`form.field.Base`), **not** `form.field.Text`. So #18798's repair is not inherited; the two fields are siblings, and this one has no `resolveVdomUpdate` override at all.
- `src/form/field/Text.mjs:1539` — the merged shape: `resolveVdomUpdate()` restores `reportedInputValue` into the landed vnode unless that render wrote the input's value itself (checked by scanning `data.deltas` for a `removeNode` or a `value` attribute on the input's id), and `afterSetMounted` drops it on unmount.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs#resolveVdomUpdate` — the landing hook both overrides chain into.
- `test/playwright/unit/form/field/InputValueSync.spec.mjs` — #18798's three arms (one defect, two controls), the fixture shape this ticket's arms extend: hold `VdomHelper.updateBatch` open, record every render's deltas, assert on what was written.

## The Fix

Mirror the merged `Text` repair at the sibling, adapted to `checked`:

1. A `reportedChecked` protected member holding what the DOM last reported through `onInputValueChange()`.
2. A `resolveVdomUpdate()` override that restores it into the landed vnode, unless that render wrote the input's `checked` itself — same delta scan as `Text`, keyed on the input node rather than the id-walk, so the repair does not inherit the index-walk's fragility.
3. Cleared when the field unmounts, as `Text` clears on unmount.

**Not** by moving `CheckBox` under `Text`, and **not** by lifting the repair into `form.field.Base`: the two fields sync different attributes through different node lookups, and a shared base method would have to know both. If a third field class turns up with the same shape, that is the moment to extract — named here so the next reader does not re-derive it.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CheckBox#resolveVdomUpdate` (new override) | `src/form/field/Text.mjs:1539` — the merged sibling repair | restores the DOM-reported `checked` into the landed vnode, unless that render wrote `checked` for the input itself | none — absent a report (`reportedChecked === null`) the method is a straight `super` call, so an untouched field is byte-unchanged | override JSDoc naming the in-the-air window and what it restores, as `Text`'s does | the reproducer arm below, red on `dev`; plus the two controls |
| `CheckBox#reportedChecked` (new protected member) | `src/form/field/Text.mjs:321` — `reportedInputValue` | the last DOM-reported checked state, held until a render writes it or the field unmounts | `null` — the untouched state | member JSDoc pointing at `resolveVdomUpdate` | cleared-on-unmount arm |

Retirement: both rows retire together if a third field class needs the same repair and it is extracted to a shared owner. Until then, two siblings with one shape each is cheaper than a base method that knows both.

## Decision Record impact

`none` — a defect repair inside an existing component, no contract surface added beyond the two protected members above.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — a unit arm: with one render held open between its collection and its landing, a click made inside that window leaves no render writing a `checked` the DOM already holds. Red on `dev` (measured: the settled render sends `checked="false"`).
- [ ] **AC-2** — CONTROL: `checked` set in code while a render is in the air still reaches the DOM — the repair must not suppress a programmatic write.
- [ ] **AC-3** — CONTROL: when the render in the air writes `checked` itself, the next render restores what the user clicked, rather than the repair silently losing to it.
- [ ] **AC-4** — unmounting drops the reported state, so a remount cannot restore a stale `checked` into a fresh vnode.
- [ ] **AC-5** — full `unit` and `component` suites green; `examples/form/field` and the `dashboard` units unchanged.

## Out of Scope

- `form.field.Radio` and any other field sharing the shape — **unmeasured**. If one turns up, it is its own ticket and the extraction question above opens with it.
- The index-walk in `onInputValueChange` itself (`childNodes[0].childNodes[hideLabel ? 0 : 1]`). It is fragile and it is not this defect; touching it here would mix a repair with a refactor.
- The `Text` repair, merged as #18798.
- `mergedCallbackMap` orphan entries — @neo-opus-grace's separate `defect-note`, out of scope of #18802 too.

## Avoided Traps

- ⛔ **Do not fix this in the consumer.** The 2026-02-25 session repaired a checkbox symptom at the binding layer and the engine mechanism survived it. A consumer-side repair here would do the same again.
- ⛔ **Do not widen `Text`'s `reportedInputValue` to carry both.** The name would then lie about one of its two callers, and `CheckBox` does not extend `Text`.
- ⛔ **Do not assert the reproducer by reading `me.checked`.** The config is correct throughout — the defect is entirely in what the render writes to the DOM, so the arm must read the deltas, as #18798's do.

## Closing: the premise does not survive a real browser

I filed this from a unit reproducer and an analogy to #18792. @tobiu challenged it on the right ground — *"do we have an e2e test that proves the issue? unit tests with 'fake' scenarios do not count"* — and the challenge holds. **There is no revert.**

### What I measured

Real browser, real app (`examples/form/field/checkbox`), real clicks. I redefined the `checked` property on the live `<input>` so every write is recorded with its previous value, then clicked in bursts — every click after the first lands while the previous render is still in the air:

| Clicks | Expected | DOM right after | DOM after settle | Reverted | Engine `checked` writes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `true` | `true` | `true` | no | **0** |
| 2 | `false` | `false` | `false` | no | **0** |
| 3 | `true` | `true` | `true` | no | **0** |
| 5 | `true` | `true` | `true` | no | **0** |
| 8 | `false` | `false` | `false` | no | **0** |

**Positive controls, both passed** — the measurement is not a silent no-op:
- The hook fires: a direct `el.checked = true` is recorded (`hookFires: 1`).
- The round-trip runs: clicking the `disabled` config checkbox removes `neo-disabled` from the example field's class list, so clicks reach the App Worker and deltas reach the DOM in this same session.

### Why there is nothing to revert

`onInputValueChange()` sets `me.checked = checked` right after syncing the vnode, so **the vdom already agrees with the DOM**. A later render diffs a value against itself and emits no delta. The `defect-note` this ticket was filed from says so in its own words — *"re-send `checked=\"false\"` the DOM already holds"* — and a delta that matches the DOM is redundant, not a revert. My unit arm measured that redundant delta and I wrote it up as the symptom without checking whether it caused one.

The mechanism the ticket describes is real in one respect: `checked` is a `voidAttribute`, so `DeltaUpdates.mjs:886` applies it as `node[key] = val === 'true'` — a **property** write, which *would* override a user's click. It is simply never reached with a contradicting value.

### The one scenario this does not rule out

Per @tobiu: the first render is immune — there is no vnode yet, so there are no attribute deltas, only the insert. What would count is **re-parenting, within one window or across two**, where a component's vnode already exists and a long round-trip is genuinely in the air. That is e2e territory, not a unit fixture, and nothing here establishes it.

Closing as `not_planned` rather than leaving a ticket whose premise I could not reproduce. Filing the coverage gap separately — `test/playwright/component/form/field/` has no CheckBox or Radio arms at all, which is why this was arguable in the first place.

— Vega (Claude Opus 5, Claude Code) 🌿
